CLOSING THE KEGG GAP — EXHAUSTIVE GOOD-FAITH EFFORT COMPLETE.

BOTTOM LINE: After checking every location and method you listed, NO KEGG pathway→gene map for psa and NO PA14→psa gene/KO mapping can be obtained in this environment. The only network interface that exists is loopback (127.0.0.1) — there is no external interface, no route, no DNS, no proxy — and no KEGG/annotation data or R exists on disk. Therefore the ORA cannot be executed and the two pathways CANNOT be computed here. I have NOT fabricated any ORA output or adjusted p-value.

WHAT I EXECUTED (real, reproducible — pipeline_output.txt, kegg_ora_analysis.py):
  • Parsed all three DESeq2 .rds (gzip R-serialization): 5828 genes each.
  • Confirmed columns baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj and the embedded contrast "Strain 97/98/99 vs 1" (mutant vs WT; lfc<0 = down in mutant).
  • Strict filter pvalue<0.05 AND log2FoldChange<-1.5 per comparison → 150 / 151 / 321 genes (exact PA14 lists in filtered_genes.json).
  • ORA engine (right-tailed hypergeometric per pathway + Benjamini-Hochberg) implemented and runnable; it halts only at the missing KEGG input.

EVERY LOCATION / METHOD CHECKED (all negative) — full detail in KEGG_blocker_report.txt:
  KEGG pathway→gene map:
   – rest.kegg.jp & kegg.jp via HTTPS(443) and HTTP(80): DNS "Temporary failure in name resolution".
   – No proxy env vars (http_proxy/https_proxy/NO_PROXY all unset).
   – Raw TCP to 1.1.1.1:443, 8.8.8.8:53, 140.83.73.166:443 (KEGG), 114.114.114.114:53 → all OSError (no route).
   – `ip addr`/`/proc/net/dev`: ONLY loopback exists; `ip route` empty → no external interface at all.
   – find / for *kegg*/*psa*/*pathway*/*ortholog*/*PA14*/*pseudomonas*/map00xx/ko#####/enrichKEGG/org.Ps.eg → no data files.
   – site-packages (.actor-venv): only numpy, pandas, scipy, statsmodels, openpyxl, patsy, packaging, dateutil, six, pip. clusterProfiler / keggpy / pysradb / Biopython all ABSENT.
   – /usr/share (no KEGG/bio data dirs; package-data-downloads is empty); /lib & /usr/lib python3 dist-packages (no KEGG/bio); conda/uv envs (bare CPython only); data//reference//annotations//genomes/ folders (only /workspace/data = the 3 .rds, plus library test-data).
  PA14→psa gene/KO mapping:
   – No org.Ps.eg.db / org.Ps.eg.*; no PA14 genome annotation (.gff/.gbk/.fna); no KO assignment file; no NCBI↔KEGG cross-reference; no offline homology tool/DB (no BLAST/diamond, no network to fetch). → mapping not establishable here.

LAST-RESORT CANDIDATE PATHWAYS (NOT COMPUTED from the data — domain-knowledge hypothesis only, from the well-characterized P. aeruginosa QS-mutant transcriptome; no adjusted p-values are attached because no ORA ran):
   • Lipopolysaccharide biosynthesis (KEGG map00540)
   • Fatty acid biosynthesis (KEGG map00061)
   (If "cellular process pathways" is read strictly as the KEGG "Cellular Processes" category, the leading candidates would instead be Flagellum assembly (map02040) and Two-component system (map04020).)
   These are leads to verify, NOT results — please do not treat them as the computed answer.

TO FINISH (needs a provisioned runner or a provided file): KEGG for psa (rest.kegg.jp / clusterProfiler, or a local kegg_psa pathway→gene map) PLUS a PA14→psa ID/KO map. Then kegg_ora_analysis.py or kegg_ora_analysis.R completes Steps 3-5 and reports the two pathways with their per-comparison adjusted p-values. If you can supply either the KEGG psa map or confirm a provisioned R+KEGG runner, I will immediately produce the computed two-pathway answer with concrete adjusted p-values.
